held_out_dataset: NASA Tropical Cyclone Sequences (Held-out test split)

next_frame_reconstruction_mse.conclusion: ConvLSTM achieves +18.35% skill score over persistence in next-frame pixel reconstruction.

intensity_forecasting_mae_kt.physical_conclusion: Intensity persistence (1.90 kt) dominates ConvLSTM intensity head (17.20 kt) because tropical cyclones have gradual short-range intensity evolution, and recurrent downscaling (64x64 px) discards eye-wall gradients.
